stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

## Verified rule from task-90f4638b (2026-10-20)

A large uniform-background field contains a matching 2-cell domino at a boundary and a lone interior colored cell. The domino is a directional emitter: use the column/row of its first cell (for the horizontal dominoes in these examples, the left cell) and draw inward, perpendicular to the domino, through the background using the lone cell's original color. Preserve the domino. If the ray encounters the lone cell in its path, recolor that lone cell to 4 and stop the ray there (do not paint past it). A ray that does not encounter it continues to the opposite boundary.

- Demo 1: 7-background 7x16. Horizontal 8 domino at top row cols 14-15; second at bottom row cols 9-10. Lone 3 at (row 3,col 9). Output has 3 down col14 from row1 through row6; 3 up col9 at rows4-5; lone 3 becomes 4; pairs unchanged.
